description: This file defines a sealed class 'FlatPositionComparer' implementing comparison logic for objects implementing 'IPositioned' and strings, used for ordering zones or positions within the OrchardCore.DisplayManagement.Zones namespace.

classes.name: FlatPositionComparer
classes.description: A singleton class providing comparison logic for positions and strings, used to order zones or layout positions within OrchardCore.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares two IPositioned objects based on their Position property.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares two strings representing positions, parsing and normalizing parts for ordering.

methods.name: GetNormalizedSpan
methods.description: Returns a normalized ReadOnlySpan<char> for a string, trimming whitespace and specific characters.

methods.name: TryNormalizeKnownPartitions
methods.description: Identifies special position keywords 'before' and 'after' and assigns them extreme integer values for comparison.
